name: CodeViewer
description:
Here's a 5-line summary:

1. The task was to improve scroll behavior in the `CodeViewer.vue` component to support auto-scrolling during content streaming.
2. An `isAtBottom` flag was added to track whether the user is scrolled to (or near) the bottom of the code viewer.
3. The `saveScrollPosition` method was updated to detect if the user is within 40px of the bottom, setting `isAtBottom` accordingly.
4. The `code` watcher was modified to either pin the scroll to the bottom (if `isAtBottom` is true) or restore the previous scroll position (if the user scrolled up).
5. A `beforeUnmount` lifecycle hook was added to clean up the scroll event listener and prevent memory leaks.
